items.decision: Use the Phase 17 facility-specific physical anchors as canonical and install an explicit facility-scoped alias/migration map for six broad predecessor anchors.
items.evidence: Phase 17 has twelve unique anchors; Phase 14 uses western-plaza, eastern-plaza, lower-bridge, and village-forge aliases for six facilities.
items.failClosedEffect: Do not bind or persist physical-map hotspot state for an ambiguous broad anchor.

items.decision: Implement the exact ordered successor validation and idempotent migration lineage without weakening the released save validator.
items.evidence: Phase 15 seam resolution and Phase 18–21 data specs reserve ordered successor migrations; no runtime implementation is part of these design packages.
items.failClosedEffect: Reject future, missing, duplicated, or out-of-order lineage and preserve export/recovery.

items.decision: Implement the exact tutorial-registry successor chain while preserving Phase 12 and prior replay history.
items.evidence: The 79-ID ledger and Phase 15/16, 17, 19, and 21 successor IDs are consistent but design-only.
items.failClosedEffect: Keep the related feature production-disabled rather than show it without contextual tutorial coverage.

items.decision: Implement immutable source/domain finalizer dispatch, V2 offers/receipts, retained-window folding, and permanent domain replay authority.
items.evidence: Fourteen dispatch identities are reserved; the required 512-receipt window and 128-receipt fold have no runtime implementation here.
items.failClosedEffect: A source/domain with no captured finalizer cannot create or claim a reward.

items.decision: Support a facility-local one-time graduation-ready snapshot owning a V2 offer, or explicitly approve a separate one-shot opportunity definition.
items.evidence: Phase 18–19 explicitly forbids fabricating an interval lesson or reusing a lesson ordinal for graduation.
items.failClosedEffect: Lessons may remain disabled; graduation must never auto-credit, duplicate, or consume a synthetic recurring opportunity.

items.decision: Approve versioned cadence, capacities, rewards, progress, mastery, relationship, stock, growth, integration, and active-profit policies.
items.evidence: Every unapproved production value remains null and every affected definition is disabled.
items.failClosedEffect: Never substitute zero, empty, Restaurant, or QA synthetic values for null production policy.

items.decision: Bind Forge Relic Stones to the existing authoritative balance through an allowlisted adapter and approve the Workshop component source policy.
items.evidence: The Forge adapter ID and Workshop baseline input policy are intentionally null.
items.failClosedEffect: Do not create a shadow Relic Stone balance or make a cross-facility input mandatory.

items.decision: Approve original Everstead copy/localization keys and public characterization rights without imitating external-franchise voices.
items.evidence: Stable functional roles exist for all 38 actors, while final visible copy remains unapproved.
items.failClosedEffect: Use approved neutral copy or defer the line; never ship imitation dialogue.

items.decision: Resolve public character/art authorization and approve facility map treatments plus missing dialogue presentation treatments.
items.evidence: Map art/CSS IDs remain null; the four blocked cutouts retain approved framed/text-only fallbacks.
items.failClosedEffect: Use transparent cutout, approved frame, or attributed text-only; never an unframed full-profile overlay.

items.decision: Run five-year maximum-approved-cadence receipt/range/checkpoint and serialized-save-size simulations.
items.evidence: Null cadence prevents a valid headroom proof.
items.failClosedEffect: Do not enable recurring production claims without bounded archive/save evidence.

items.decision: Implement and validate compact physical-map icons/sheets, keyboard/focus/screen-reader behavior, reduced motion, resize, and localization expansion.
items.evidence: The interaction contract exists but production browser/device evidence is absent.
items.failClosedEffect: Do not expose an inaccessible or detached facility-management substitute.

items.decision: Satisfy every required Phase 20–21 release gate on the integrated candidate, including offline, multi-tab, recovery, mobile, accessibility, and prior-phase regression evidence.
items.evidence: All 27 release gates are required, blocked, and evidence-null; Web Storage's no-CAS residual risk remains documented.
